Frequently Asked Questions

Microsoft Partner Engineering FAQ

Answers to common questions about our Microsoft partnership, intellectual property ownership, security governance, and delivery timelines.

How does Coralgenz's Microsoft Partner status benefit our project?
As an official Microsoft AI Cloud Partner, Coralgenz receives direct engineering escalations, early access to new Azure OpenAI Foundry APIs, verified deployment templates, and cloud architectural validation from Microsoft architects. This ensures your systems are built strictly following Microsoft Well-Architected Framework guidelines.
Is our data safe when deploying Azure OpenAI and Copilot solutions?
Yes, 100%. We deploy Azure OpenAI Service within your dedicated Azure subscription using private VNet endpoints, customer-managed encryption keys in Azure Key Vault, and zero-trust IAM. Under Microsoft's enterprise cognitive agreements, your business prompts, embeddings, and sensitive data are strictly isolated and never used to train public foundation models.
Do we retain full ownership of source code and intellectual property?
Yes. Every line of code, Terraform script, CI/CD pipeline, and documentation engineered by Coralgenz is 100% transferred to your organization upon milestone completion. We provide unencumbered commercial copyright ownership with zero ongoing licensing fees or proprietary vendor lock-in.
Can Coralgenz integrate Microsoft Azure with our existing systems and Salesforce?
Absolutely. As verified partners of both Microsoft and Salesforce, we specialize in high-throughput bidirectional data synchronization between Azure microservices, Azure Event Grid, and Salesforce CRM / Data Cloud. We also support hybrid on-premise systems via Azure Arc and secure VPN tunnels.
What is your production incident response SLA?
We provide guaranteed <24h turnaround for critical production incidents, backed by direct escalation to senior engineering leads and company founders. Our managed cloud retainers include automated uptime alerts, log analytics monitoring, and continuous weekly health audits.
